claims.statement: Cignal AI (independent optical market research, public summary of its Oct 2026 scale-across report): Raman amplification is a major cost driver in scale-across line systems and the pump lasers behind it are among the tightest parts of the optical supply chain; a report chapter is titled 'Raman on Most Links Strains Pump Supply'. First non-supplier origin on the pump-laser-in-scale-across edge (L8 corroboration of Lumentum's self-reported supply tightness). The public summary names no pump supplier and gives no share; its revenue forecasts are time-varying and are not put on the graph.
